name: render
description: Generates render.yaml and deploys existing Render server services through the API, with status, logs and environment variable tools.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Configure and deploy an existing Render server service, then check its status and logs.

credentialCards.title: Connect Render
credentialCards.label: Render API
credentialCards.intro: Save a Render API key for deploying this site from Tovu. Use it to look up existing services, deploy your server, check status and logs, and manage environment variables. Writing the deployment settings file needs no key. Untested: this connection hasn't been tried end to end yet.
credentialCards.keyHint: In Render, open Account Settings → API Keys → Create API Key. The key has the same access as your Render account, so use an account that can deploy the site's service.
